objective: Close M08.12 as an executable gate under ADR 0008's relay-only contract: an effect initiated from an attached editor is relayed to the daemon under the user's own session, its refusal parks through the App's spend-approval lane as the byte-derived card, and the editor receives a typed notification carrying the challenge's coordinates (both commitments, the audience, the target scope, the receipt ref, the preimage sha256) and the decision links — never a facet, a preimage, a grant or a key. The relay authenticates the attach by its active editor-open access lease (which never authorizes the effect), holds no key, mints nothing, caches no grant and adds no decision path; the decision is taken on the App card; the daemon's receipts and admitted records are identical across attach surfaces, read back from the daemon.
falsifiable_claim: npm run check:editor-challenge-relay --workspace=@ioi/hypervisor-app (scripts/check-editor-challenge-relay.mjs --drills) binds every clause to a floored app gate or one of the runner's own legs, requires the live legs to be scheduled with a prerequisite and a ruling, drives the relay in-process over the tracked M03.9 challenge fixture with an injected transport and grant projection — an unknown, revoked, wrong-action or foreign attach lease and an effect on another environment refused by name with nothing submitted; the park equal to the App lane's minus the attach refs under the user's own identity with a caller-supplied grant stripped and no grant on the record; the notification's grammar (the challenge's hashes, audience, receipt ref and preimage sha, run-bound links, the source adapter) with its refusals of a smuggled facet and a wrong hash; a refusal park's notification without an approve link; the decision through the lane's own function with the identical retry and the daemon's typed refusal; receipt parity over the same operation admitted through the relay and through the App with the parity oracle's negative — executes the extension's VS-Code-free renderer tests, pins the relay's sources (no authority module, no minter, no key path or test-signer flag, no grant member, submits only through the lane, no decision path; the lane's single mint call site unchanged; the serve route admitted and without a decision route; the extension wired), drills the verdict and requires the three canon owners to name the gate. mutate:editor-challenge-relay plants nineteen defects and each goes red. The full gate runs the REAL relay: an attach tuple created in an isolated daemon (an environment, an editor service, an editor access lease — no editor runtime) under the wallet fixture with the runner's own serve; the live deployment_intent effect relayed and parked with the daemon's audience, a foreign attach refused, the notification returned and persisted, the operator's approve through the notification's own link, the daemon's typed refusal with both receipts read back; the simulator-mode create driven through the relay and through the App, both approved and admitted, the daemon's receipts and admitted records compared member by member modulo identities; then the composed gates inside the isolated-egress harness; exit 0 only on a pass, 2 on a named failure, 1 on a fail.
